profile.ja: 対魔忍。代々ふうまの家に仕える下忍の家柄で、五車学園の同級生でもある。獣遁の術使いの中でも花形とされる“獣化忍”で、獣の力を身体に宿す能力を持つ。彼女の獣化はタイプ“Ｄｅｖｉｌｆｉｓｈ”、つまりタコ化する。名前は蛇子なのにタコになるというよく分からん女だ……と主人公には言われるが、本人曰く『蛇子』は元々曾祖母の名前で、その曾祖母は大蛇に変化する獣化忍だったという。タコ化すると両足がそれぞれ一本の太いタコ足となり、この両足と両手に持った忍者小太刀四本による四刀流戦法を得意としている。身長は自称１５０センチ。１４９センチだろうと言われると墨を吐いて怒る。彼女が獣化して放つ墨は五車では有名で、体に付けば魚臭さが三日三晩消えないと恐れられている。
profile.en: A Taimanin and a junior ninja from a lineage that has served the Fuuma family for generations, also a classmate at Gosha Academy. She is a "Beast-Transformation Ninja," a star among those who wield beast-transformation techniques, possessing the ability to imbue her body with animal power. Her transformation type is "Devilfish," meaning she turns into an octopus. Though her name means "Snake Child," she becomes an octopus, which the protagonist finds baffling; she explains that "Hebiko" was originally her great-grandmother's name, who herself was a beast-transformation ninja that turned into a great snake. When she octopus-transforms, each leg becomes a single thick tentacle, and she favors a four-blade style using those tentacles and four ninja short swords. She claims to be 150 cm tall; when told she's probably 149 cm, she spits ink in anger. The ink she releases in her beast form is infamous at Gosha, feared for leaving a fishy stench on anyone's body for three days and nights.

text.ja: 相州蛇子だよ～。これからよろしくね♪　って、いまさらかなぁ？　でもこれからは、もっと一緒にいられるね！
text.en: I'm Aishu Hebiko~. Nice to meet you♪...maybe that's a bit late? But from now on, we'll get to spend even more time together!

text.ja: ねえねえー。えへへ、呼んでみただけ。でも、たまには構って欲しいな～
text.en: Hey hey— hee hee, I just called you. But sometimes I want you to pay attention to me~

text.ja: 索敵が必要な時はいつでも言ってね。この吸盤センサーがどこに隠れていても見つけ出すわ
text.en: Just tell me whenever you need a search. This suction-cup sensor will find anything, no matter where it's hidden.

text.ja: 喧嘩なんてしちゃダメよ。仲良くしないと、この墨で両成敗しちゃうんだから
text.en: Don't start a fight. If we don't get along, I'll wipe us both out with this ink.

text.ja: もっと頼れるところ、見せてよね。やればできる子だって、蛇子は知ってるんだから
text.en: Show me that you can be more dependable. I know you can do it, after all.

text.ja: タコ足の吸盤が気持ち悪いですって～！？　墨吐くわよ！　三日三晩は魚臭いわよ？
text.en: You say the tentacle suckers feel gross!? I'll spit ink! It'll smell fishy for three days and nights!

text.ja: ふうまちゃん、いつも面倒くさがりでだらしないから、蛇子がちゃんとしてあげないとね。……でも、頼りになる所もあるんだよ
text.en: Fuuma-chan, you're always lazy and sloppy, so I have to keep you in line. ...but you do have your reliable moments.

text.ja: 小さいころは、なんでタコ足なんだろうって悩んだこともあったけど、今は結構気に入ってるかな。このおかげで、守れた仲間もいるしね
text.en: When I was little I wondered why I got octopus legs, but now I kinda like them. Thanks to them I've been able to protect my comrades.
